CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.dim_customer
(
    customer_key BIGINT,
    customer_id INT,
    first_name VARCHAR(100),
    last_name VARCHAR(100),
    full_name VARCHAR(201),
    email VARCHAR(255),
    phone VARCHAR(50),
    gender VARCHAR(30),
    date_of_birth DATETIME2,
    registration_date DATETIME2,
    customer_status VARCHAR(50),
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/dim_customer/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);


SELECT TOP 10 *
FROM dbo.dim_customer;



--  Dim Product

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.dim_product
(
    product_key INT,
    product_id INT,
    product_name VARCHAR(255),
    category_id INT,
    category_name VARCHAR(100),
    brand VARCHAR(100),
    price DECIMAL(12,2),
    cost DECIMAL(12,2),
    stock_quantity INT,
    product_status VARCHAR(50),
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/dim_product/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);



SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN product_key = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_product_rows
FROM dbo.dim_product;


-- Dim Date

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.dim_date
(
    date_key INT,
    calendar_date DATE,
    year INT,
    quarter INT,
    month_number INT,
    month_name VARCHAR(20),
    year_month VARCHAR(7),
    day_of_month INT,
    day_of_week INT,
    day_name VARCHAR(20),
    is_weekend BIT
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/dim_date/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_dates,
    MIN(calendar_date) AS first_date,
    MAX(calendar_date) AS last_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date_key) AS distinct_date_keys
FROM dbo.dim_date;



-- Dim Address

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.dim_address
(
    address_key INT,
    address_id INT,
    customer_id INT,
    address_type VARCHAR(50),
    address_line1 VARCHAR(255),
    address_line2 VARCHAR(255),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    postal_code VARCHAR(30),
    country VARCHAR(100),
    is_default BIT,
    is_effective_default BIT,
    created_at DATETIME2,
    updated_at DATETIME2
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'dimensional_model/dim_address/',
    DATA_SOURCE = EcommerceGold,
    FILE_FORMAT = ParquetFormat
);


SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT address_id) AS distinct_addresses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN address_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS null_address_ids
FROM dbo.dim_address;
